model.description: Create images from a description, or use up to 10 reference images to change a scene, combine subjects, or guide its appearance. Edit selected areas with a mask, extend an image with outpainting, and work at resolutions up to 4K. Text rendering is moderate: prefer short wording and proofread it; dense infographics are not recommended.
